questions.q_en: The length of the largest possible rod that can be placed in a cubical room is 42√3 m. The surface area (in m2) of the largest possible sphere that fit within the cubical room is: [Use π = 22/7]
questions.solution_en:
Length of the largest possible rod = 42√3 m

Side of cube = 42√3/√3 = 42 m

Radius of largest possible sphere that fit within cube = 42/2 = 21 m

Surface area of the largest possible sphere = 4 * 22/7 * 21 * 21

= 88 * 63

= 5544 m2

questions.q_en: The internal length, breadth and height of a cuboidal room are 12 m, 8 m, and 10 m, respectively. The total cost (in ₹) of whitewashing only all four walls of the cost of ₹ 25 per m2, is:
questions.solution_en:
L = 12 m, B = 8 m, and H = 10 m

Surface area of all the four walls of the room = 2H(L + B)

= 2 * 10 * (12 + 8)

= 400 m2

Cost of whitewashing only all four walls = 400 * 25

= ₹10000

questions.q_en: A solid metallic cube of side 9 cm and a solid metallic cuboid having dimensions 5 cm, 13 cm, 31 cm are melted to form a single cube. How much (in ₹) is the cost to polish the new cube at a rate of ₹ 10 per cm2?
questions.solution_en:
The volume of the cube = 93 = 729 cm3

The volume of the cuboid = 5 * 13 * 31 = 2015 cm3

The volume of the new cube = 729 + 2015 = 2744 cm3

The side of the cube = ∛2744 = 14 cm

The surface area of the cube = 6 * 142 = 1176 cm2

Since, the cost of polish the cube = ₹ 10 per cm2

So, the total cost of polishing the cube = 1176 * 10 = ₹11760

questions.q_en: A cuboidal water purifier can carry 10 litres of water. Its breadth is 1/5 of its height and length is 1/3 of the sum of the breadth and height. The height of the tank is:
questions.solution_en:
Let:-

H = height,

So, B = H/5, and L = (B + H) / 3

= (H/5 + H) / 3

= (6H/5) / 3 = 2H/5.

Volume = 10 L = 10000 cm3 = L X B X H = (2H/5) X (H/5) X H = 2H3 / 25.

10000 = 2H3 / 25

H3 = 125000

H = 50 cm.

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: A cuboid with dimensions 20 cm, 12 cm, and 10 cm is cut into 8 identical pieces by 3 cuts. What will be the total surface area of all the pieces?
questions.solution_en:
Dimensions of identical pieces:

Length = 20/2 = 10 cm

Width = 12/2 = 6 cm

Height = 10/2 = 5 cm

Surface area of 8 identical cuboids = 8*2(10*6 + 6*5 + 5*10)

= 16(60 + 30 + 50)

= 16 * 140

= 2240 cm2

questions.q_en: The area of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box is 120 cm2, 72 cm2 and 60 cm2, respectively. Find the volume (in cm3) of the box.
questions.solution_en:
· lb = 120 cm2, bh = 72 cm2, hl = 60 cm2

· (lb)(bh)(hl) = (l * b * h)² = 120 X 72 X 60 = 602 X 122

· Volume of the box = l X b X h = √(602 X 122) = 720 cm3

questions.q_en: A solid metallic cube having surface area of 54 cm2 is melted to form smaller cubes of surface area 8/12 cm2 each. Find the number of smaller cubes.

Surface area of larger metallic cube = 54 cm2

a2 = 9

a = 3

6b2 = 2/3

b2 = 1/9

b = 1/3

= 33/(1/3)3

= 729

questions.q_en: Find the surface area (in cm²) of a cardboard box in the shape of a cuboid whose length is 60 cm, breadth is half its length and height is one-third of its breadth.
questions.solution_en:
Length = 60 cm

Breadth = 60 / 2 = 30 cm

Height = 30 / 3 = 10 cm

Surface area = 2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(60 X 30 + 30 X 10 + 10 X 60) = 2(1800 + 300 + 600) = 2 X 2700 = 5400 cm²

Option (b) is the correct answer

questions.q_en: The length of a cuboid is 4 cm. If the breadth of the cuboid is four times of its length and height of the cuboid is twice of its length, then what is the lateral surface area of the cuboid?
questions.solution_en:
Length of cuboid = 4 cm

Breadth of cuboid = 4 * 4 = 16 cm

Height of cuboid = 4 * 2 = 8 cm

Lateral surface area of the cuboid = 2(lh + bh)

= 2 * (4 * 8 + 16 * 8)

= 320 cm2

questions.q_en: A hall of 10 m length, 5 m width and 6 m height is to be painted (one side only). Determine the total surface area to be painted. (Neglect the area of windows and doors) (floor area is NOT to be painted)

Area to be painted = Total surface area of the room - Area of the floor

= 2 * [10 * 5 + 10 * 6 + 5 * 6] - 10 * 5

= 2 * 140 - 50

= 280 - 30

= 230 m2

questions.q_en: The volume of a cube is four times the volume of a cuboid. If the sides of the cuboid are 32 cm, 8 cm and 4 cm, then find the ratio of the total surface area of the cube to that of the cuboid.
questions.solution_en:
l = 32 cm, b = 8 cm, h = 4 cm

Volume of a cube = 4 * volume of a cuboid

a3 = 4 * 32 * 8 * 4 = 163

a = 16 cm

Ratio of the total surface area of the cube to that of the cuboid =>

= 6*16*16/2(32*8 + 8*4 + 32*4)

= 3*16*16/32(8 + 1 + 4)

= 24/13

questions.q_en: A rectangular sheet of metal is 60 cm by 25 cm. Equal squares of side 5 cm are cut off at the corners and the remainder is folded up to form an open rectangular box. Find the volume of the box.

Length after cuts = 60 - 2*5 = 50 cm

Width = 25 - 2*5 = 15 cm

Height = 5 cm (side of square)

Volume = 50 * 15 * 5 = 3,750 cm3

questions.q_en: Find the whole surface area of a cuboid having a length of 19 cm, breadth of 9 cm and height of 4.5 cm.
Three cubes each of side 5 cm are joined end to end. The surface area of the resulting cuboid is:
questions.solution_en:
Cuboid: Length = 5 X 3 = 15 cm,

Width = 5 cm, Height = 5 cm

We know that:-

Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(15 X 5 + 15 X 5 + 5 X 5)

= 2(75 + 75 + 25) = 2 X 175 = 350 cm2

Option (c) is the correct answer.
